question: Anil Prakash Joshi received the Padma Bhushan Award 2020 in the field of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**social work.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anil Prakash Joshi **received the **Padma Bhushan Award 2020** in the field o**f social work.**
 
• Environmentalist Dr. Anil Prakash Joshi has been awarded the **Mother Teresa Memorial Award for Social Justice 2021.**
 
• **Vidyut Mohan**, winner of the Earth shot Prize, and **Ridhima Pandey,** a young environmental activist were also the recipients of the award.
 
• **Dr. Abraham Mathai**, the founder and chairman of** Harmony foundation** felicitated the awardees.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Padma Awards (2021) are split into three categories:

 
 
• Padma Vibhushan (highest civilian honours.): 7
 
• Padma Bhushan: 10
 
• Padma Shri: 102
 
• Women Awardees: 29
 
• Category of foreigners/NRI/PIO/OCI: 10
 
• Posthumous: 16
 
• Transgender Awardee: 1
